Different ways of selling.

A growth system tailored to yours, and ready to evolve as you grow.

Whether you serve businesses, consumers or both, start with how customers choose you. Some businesses combine an appointment with a quote. The system should support that journey, rather than force you into someone else’s process.

Danielle · Illustrative salon owner
A time, a person and a place

Appointment-based

The customer needs a suitable slot and a clear way to prepare, change or follow up on a visit. Your team needs the service, staff and availability to line up.

A practical fit for the way you work

Your process comes first.

Choose the stages, information, calendars and responsibilities that matter to your business. A one-person service and a team serving several locations may need different views, permissions and handoffs.

As you grow, review what needs to change: new staff, services, customer groups or locations. Expansion depends on the agreed scope, platform access and configuration; tailored does not mean unlimited custom development.
